sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: FDCAN TT local and global time register (FDCAN_TTLGT)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.6.14 "FDCAN TT local and global time register (FDCAN_TTLGT)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3737.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0134
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:16 GT[15:0]: Global time
Non-fractional part of the sum of the node local time and its local offset (see Section71.4.13).
0x0000 to FFFF Global time value of FDCAN network
Bits 15:0 LT[15:0]: Local time
Non-fractional part of local time, incremented once each local NTU (see Section71.4.13).
0x0000 to FFFF Local time value of FDCAN node
